title: OPS — Enhance posting reminder with specific video recommendation
description: remind-post.ts sends a generic 'post X more videos' message. Enhance to pick the top-scored unposted video from auto-delivered.jsonl and include: video_id + topic snippet + /deliver <id> hint. Operator goes from 'I need to post' to 'here's exactly what to post' in one notification. Single file change, stdlib only.

tasks.title: Enhance scripts/remind-post.ts to include top video recommendation
tasks.description: In remind-post.ts, after calculating postsRemaining, add: function pickNextVideo(): {video_id:string, topic:string} | null that reads workspace/scs001/auto-delivered.jsonl and workspace/scs001/manual-posts.jsonl. Filter out posted IDs. Sort by viral_score desc. Return top entry with existing mp4_path. In the reminder message, if a video is found, append: 'Next up: `<video_id>` — <topic slice 60 chars>\n→ /deliver <video_id>'. Keep file under 90 lines.
